about: Make history as the legendary Master Assassin, Ezio Auditore da Firenze, in Assassin’s Creed® The Ezio Collection, which includes the acclaimed single-player campaigns and single-player add-on content* from three games: Assassin’s Creed® II…

Play as Ezio, the most iconic Assassin in the franchise, and follow his  journey from a young man learning the ways of the Assassins in 15th-century Renaissance Italy, then into Rome where he takes leadership of the entire Brotherhood of Assassins.
Finally embark on Ezio’s final adventure in 16th-century Constantinople, as he walks in the footsteps of his great mentor, Altaïr, on a journey of discovery and revelation .
Also included are the short films Assassin’s Creed Lineage® and Assassin’s Creed Embers™.
